speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To help me determine the cause, have you noticed any rash, photophobia, or changes in your fetal movements? When did these symptoms first start?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. The sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise in a 30-week pregnant patient, specifically following the consumption of ice cream three days ago, raises a strong suspicion for Listeriosis. Do you have a history of close contact with anyone who is ill, or have you consumed unpasteurized dairy products or soft cheeses?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.
